elements.requirement: In the Companies Acts, a written resolution means a resolution of a private company that is proposed and passed in accordance with Chapter 2 of Part 13.
elements.quote: means a resolution of a private company proposed and passed in accordance with this Chapter

elements.requirement: A resolution under section 168 removing a director before the expiration of their period of office may not be passed as a written resolution.
elements.quote: a resolution under section 168 removing a director before the expiration of his period of office

elements.requirement: A resolution under section 510 removing an auditor before the expiration of their term of office may not be passed as a written resolution.
elements.quote: a resolution under section 510 removing an auditor before the expiration of his term of office

elements.requirement: A resolution may be proposed as a written resolution by the directors of a private company pursuant to section 291.
elements.quote: by the directors of a private company (see section 291)

elements.requirement: A resolution may be proposed as a written resolution by the members of a private company pursuant to sections 292 to 295.
elements.quote: by the members of a private company (see sections 292 to 295)

elements.requirement: References in enactments passed or made before Chapter 2 of Part 13 comes into force to a resolution of a company in general meeting, or to a resolution of a meeting of a class of members of the company, have effect as if they included references to a written resolution of the members, or of a class of members, of a private company as appropriate.
elements.quote: have effect as if they included references to a written resolution of the members, or of a class of members, of a private company (as appropriate)

elements.requirement: A written resolution of a private company has effect as if passed by the company in general meeting, or by a meeting of a class of members of the company, as the case may be.
elements.quote: has effect as if passed (as the case may be)— (a) by the company in general meeting, or (b) by a meeting of a class of members of the company

elements.requirement: References in enactments passed or made before section 288 comes into force to a meeting at which a resolution is passed, or to members voting in favour of a resolution, must be construed in accordance with the provision that a written resolution takes effect as if passed at a general meeting or class meeting.
elements.quote: references in enactments passed or made before this section comes into force to a meeting at which a resolution is passed or to members voting in favour of a resolution shall be construed accordingly
